title: La Roche-Posay unveils first Anthelios sunscreen featuring bemotrizinol (BEMT)
summary: The L’Oréal-owned dermatological beauty brand’s new Anthelios UV Defense SPF 50 Sunscreen has hit the US market containing BEMT, the first new ingredient approved by the FDA for use in over-the-counter SPFs in the states since 1999
